guarantees.claim: Each bit i of data_o[1] is continuously assigned to lfsr_state at the index RndCnstSharePerm[i], implementing a static permutation of LFSR state bits.

assumptions.claim: For every i in [0, Width-1], RndCnstSharePerm[i] is a valid index into lfsr_state (less than the bit width of lfsr_state).
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds index may read X from lfsr_state, propagating unknown values on data_o[1], corrupting the mask share and potentially exposing secrets or causing functional failure.

uncertain_points.claim: The entropy quality of data_o[1] fully relies on lfsr_state being properly seeded and updated elsewhere; a weak or stuck LFSR state would make the mask predictable.
uncertain_points.cond: when lfsr_state is not properly reseeded / advanced
uncertain_points.risk: Predictable mask shares can break SCA resistance or leak secret information.
